title: 第212章 千局落定生父现一影潜出破迷局第211章 魔坛列阵决生死内奸倒戈乱军心
content_zh:
第212章千局落定生父现，一影潜出破迷局
粉色妖气瞬间向后军疾驰而去，妲己全力拦截作乱的内奸一行人。
可就在短暂分心之际，祭坛之上，右护法抬手引动血槽内所有魔血，暗红色光柱冲天而起，径直灌入下方断魂渊裂隙。
大地剧烈震颤，渊底传来更加狂暴的嘶吼，封印光幕之上，浮现出密密麻麻的裂痕！
邪祭仪式，已经完成大半。
蔡文姬抬头望向不断开裂的封印光幕，深知不能再拖延下去了。
她看向身旁杨玉环，沉声道：“师姐，合力催动清音共鸣，强行开辟一条通路！无论付出何等代价，今日必须登上黑石祭坛！”
金色与淡粉色音波交织升腾，化作一道贯通天地的音刃，朝着前方密密麻麻的魔军阵线狠狠斩落！
金粉交织的巨大音刃横贯荒原，狂暴音浪向前轰然席卷。
阻拦在前排的魔兵被音波冲击掀飞，漆黑魔气层层消融，密密麻麻的军阵硬生生被撕开一道狭长通道，碎石与黑血四处飞溅。
趁着阵线缺口成型，蔡文姬足尖点水，踏着气流向前疾驰，杨玉环怀抱琵琶紧随左右。
“休想靠近祭坛！”
魅音魔使厉声尖喝，拼尽残余灵力拨动魔琴，无数漆黑音丝交织成巨网，拦在通道正中。
【月辰星落】！
嫦娥及时调转月华力量，银白色光幕迎上魔音巨网，两种力量不断碰撞湮灭，半空炸开滚滚黑雾。
铠嘶吼一声，【不灭魔躯】力量催动到极限，带领战魂军死死缠住李靖主力，不让对方抽身回防祭坛。
韩信银枪如龙，来回奔袭封堵想要合拢缺口的魔兵，为蔡文姬二人争取转瞬即逝的时机。
后军之中，战局同样焦灼。
妲己【偶像魅力】光球不断释放，分化内奸带领的叛党，粉色妖气缠绕几名倒戈修士，瓦解他们体内魔渊秘法。
那名清风宗叛长老眼中满是疯狂，不惜燃烧自身修为引爆魔毒：“所有人一起陪葬！”

西施立刻调动大片水流形成隔离屏障，汹涌水流裹住爆炸冲击，毒雾被水体牢牢锁住，没能扩散伤害医帐内的伤员。
“叛乱之人尽数制服！”妲己高声传讯，后军混乱逐渐平息，但一番缠斗之下，联军侧翼防线已经多处疲弱。
荒原大地持续震颤，黑石祭坛上血色纹路愈发明亮。
暗红色光柱源源不断灌入断魂渊裂隙，封印屏障的裂痕还在持续蔓延，渊底狂暴的嘶吼声声震旷野，一股恐怖无比的气息正在缓缓苏醒。
右护法静静立在祭坛最高一层石阶，黑袍随风猎猎作响，淡漠注视疾驰而来的两道身影。
“费尽心力冲到此处，倒是难得。”
他缓缓抬起右手，掌心萦绕流转着黑红交织的浓郁魔元，“清音宗最后的血脉，墨渊留下的继承者，你很想知晓所有真相，对不对？”
蔡文姬落在祭坛下层石台，胡笳琴悬浮横于身前，金色清音源源不断自琴弦流淌而出，抵御扑面而来的腐蚀魔气：
“千年恩怨，魔渊浩劫，今日一并了结。停止邪祭，修复渊底封印，我可以留你一线生机。”
content_en:
Chapter 212 The whole game is settled. The biological father appears, and a shadow sneaks out to break the mystery.
The pink demonic energy galloped towards the rear army in an instant, and Daji tried her best to intercept the traitor and his group who were making trouble.
But when he was briefly distracted, on top of the altar, the right protector raised his hand to activate all the demon blood in the blood tank. Dark red light pillars rose into the sky and poured directly into the crack of Soul-Desolating Abyss below.
The earth trembled violently, an even more violent roar came from the bottom of the abyss, and dense cracks appeared above the sealed light curtain!
The evil sacrifice ceremony has been mostly completed.
Cai Wenji looked up at the cracking sealing light curtain, knowing that she could not delay it any longer.
She looked at Yang Yuhuan beside her and said in a deep voice: "Senior sister, work together to activate the Qingyin resonance and forcibly open a passage! No matter what the price, we must climb the Black Stone Altar today!"
Golden and light pink sound waves intertwined and rose, turning into a sound blade that penetrated the sky and the earth, slashing down towards the densely packed demon army front!
The huge sound blade intertwined with gold powder spread across the wasteland, and the violent sound waves swept forward.
The demonic soldiers blocking the front row were thrown away by the sound wave impact, and the dark demonic energy melted away layer by layer. A long and narrow passage was torn open in the dense military formation, and rubble and black blood flew everywhere.
Taking advantage of the gap in the formation, Cai Wenji touched the water with her toes and galloped forward on the air current. Yang Yuhuan followed closely with her pipa in her arms.
"Don't even think about getting close to the altar!"
The Meiyin Demon Envoy screamed loudly, and used all his remaining spiritual power to play the magic piano. Countless pitch-black musical filaments intertwined into a giant net, blocking the middle of the passage.
[The moon and stars fall]!
Chang'e transferred the power of the moonlight in time, and the silver-white light curtain met the giant magic sound net. The two forces continued to collide and annihilate, and billowing black mist exploded in mid-air.
Kai roared, and the power of [Immortal Demonic Body] was pushed to the limit, leading the war spirit army to tightly entangle Li Jing's main force, preventing the opponent from getting away and returning to the altar.
Han Xin's silver spear was like a dragon, rushing back and forth to block the magic soldiers who wanted to close the gap, and bought a fleeting opportunity for Cai Wenji and Cai Wenji.
Among the rear troops, the battle situation was equally anxious.
Daji's [Idol Charm] ball of light continued to release, dividing the rebel party led by the traitor. The pink demonic energy entangled several defecting monks, disintegrating the secrets of the demonic abyss in their bodies.
The rebellious elder of the Qingfeng Sect had madness in his eyes, and he did not hesitate to burn his own cultivation to detonate the magic poison: "Everyone will be buried together!"
Xi Shi immediately mobilized a large water flow to form an isolation barrier. The turbulent water flow enveloped the explosion impact, and the poisonous mist was firmly locked in the water body, unable to spread and harm the wounded in the medical tent.
"All the rebels have been subdued!" Daji shouted loudly, and the chaos in the rear army gradually subsided. However, after a struggle, the coalition's flank defenses were already weak in many places.
The wasteland ground continued to tremble, and the bloody lines on the black stone altar became brighter and brighter.
Dark red beams of light continued to pour into the cracks of the Broken Soul Abyss, and the cracks in the sealing barrier continued to spread. The violent roars from the bottom of the abyss shook the wilderness, and a terrifying aura was slowly awakening.
The right protector stood quietly on the highest stone steps of the altar, his black robe rustling in the wind, looking indifferently at the two figures speeding towards him.
"It's rare to go through all the effort to get here."
He slowly raised his right hand, with rich black and red demonic energy lingering in his palm, "The last bloodline of the Qingyin Sect, the successor left by Mo Yuan, you really want to know all the truth, don't you?"
Cai Wenji landed on the stone platform at the bottom of the altar. The Hujia Qin was suspended in front of her. The golden clear sound continuously flowed from the strings to resist the corrosive evil energy coming towards her face:
"Thousands of years of grievances and the catastrophe of the Demon Abyss have been settled today. Stop the evil sacrifices and repair the seal at the bottom of the abyss. I can leave you a glimmer of hope."
